name: ecc-s100-lib
description: Integration workspace for S-100 Interoperability Project viewer packages.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ecc/s100-viewer && npm run build -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-nasa-ammos && npm run build -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-cesium
scripts.build:release-target: npm run build -w @ecc/s100-viewer && npm run build -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-nasa-ammos && npm run build -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-cesium
scripts.check: npm run check -w @ecc/s100-viewer && npm run check -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-nasa-ammos && npm run check -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-cesium
scripts.check:release-target: npm run check -w @ecc/s100-viewer && npm run check -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-nasa-ammos && npm run check -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-cesium
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ecc/s100-viewer && npm run test -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-nasa-ammos && npm run test -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-cesium
scripts.test:release-target: npm run test -w @ecc/s100-viewer && npm run test -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-nasa-ammos && npm run test -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-cesium
scripts.pack:release-target:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run --cache /tmp/ecc-s100-viewer-npm-cache -w @ecc/s100-viewer && npm pack --dry-run --cache /tmp/ecc-s100-viewer-npm-cache -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-nasa-ammos && npm pack --dry-run --cache /tmp/ecc-s100-viewer-npm-cache -w @ecc/s100-viewer-adapter-cesium
